Subject: [{{{org_name}}}] Your application needs updates before a decision
Hello {{{contact_first_name}}},
Our review team has carefully reviewed {{{org_name}}}'s application. Before a decision can be made, we need a few updates or additional details.
Review Notes: {{{return_comments}}}

If anything is unclear or you need help, reply to: [grants.support@wadhwanifoundation.org](mailto:grants.support@wadhwanifoundation.org)
Best regards, {{{pl_name}}} Wadhwani Grants
